title: ACTV Studio IRL: Vuori Burlington x YogaSix
description: Join Vuori Burlington for an ACTV Studio IRL on November 7th
long_description:
Join Vuori Burlington for an ACTV Studio IRL on November 7th

About this Event

Join Vuori Burlington for an in-store workout on Saturday, November 7th. Led by YogaSix, enjoy a Y6 Core Express class. After class, all attendees are invited in-store for shopping & refreshments.
8:00am - 9:00am: Class
9:00am - 10:00am: Shopping + Refreshments
RSVP to reserve your spot! Please be sure to bring a mat.

Also check out other in Boston, Workshops in Boston.
